sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: Practice Arithmetic Operations in Shell. The tasks below retain the source filenames, data and required behavior; explanations are locally written.

sections.title: Define variables for fruit costs
sections.content:
Set pineapple, banana, watermelon and basket costs to 50, 4, 23 and 1 cents.

```bash
COST_PINEAPPLE=50
COST_BANANA=4
COST_WATERMELON=23
COST_BASKET=1
```
sections.content_vi:
Đặt giá dứa, chuối, dưa hấu và giỏ lần lượt là 50, 4, 23 và 1 xu.

```bash
COST_PINEAPPLE=50
COST_BANANA=4
COST_WATERMELON=23
COST_BASKET=1
```

sections.title: Calculate the total cost
sections.content:
Calculate one pineapple, two bananas, three watermelons and one basket in TOTAL.

```bash
TOTAL=$((COST_PINEAPPLE + COST_BANANA*2 + COST_WATERMELON*3 + COST_BASKET))
```
sections.content_vi:
Tính TOTAL cho một quả dứa, hai quả chuối, ba quả dưa hấu và một giỏ.

```bash
TOTAL=$((COST_PINEAPPLE + COST_BANANA*2 + COST_WATERMELON*3 + COST_BASKET))
```
